# Millionærklubben: Tør man gå ind i aktiemarkedet lige nu?

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-09-25  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Millionærklubben episode (EuroInvestor) looks at a nervous market: US 30-year yields are at their highest since 2004, oil prices are volatile and AI financing is starting to crack, marked by Oracle's force majeure notice on its Project Jupiter data centre. The panel covers Maersk's steep run-up (hold, no new buying), Novo Nordisk's weak capital markets day, McDonald's disappointing investor day, oil service stocks (constructive), Meta's AI agent app, GN Store Nord and Strategy/bitcoin. The overall message is cautious long-term optimism: invest gradually rather than sit in cash.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 MAERSK-B — A.P. Møller - Mærsk | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lars would not buy after the steep run-up (RSI 85-90, above the trend channel) but will not sell. He keeps holding for a possible large dividend.

#### Reasoning

Guest analyst Lars Persson: the stock rose from 16k to 20k in a week in August, may have had a short squeeze, and is technically overbought. Longer routes around the Red Sea and pre-booked Christmas freight support pricing for now. The crisis will normalise eventually, so there is limited upside left (2-3k DKK). He holds rather than buys. Michelle suggests taking some profit off the top.

#### Sell Triggers

- Iran/US deal reopens Hormuz and Red Sea shipping
- Normalisation of freight rates
- Price falls back towards the long-term trend (~15,000)

> *"Så jeg vil nok holde min mærsk aktie det næste stykke tid og se, om den kan holde sig flydende heroppe."*

---

### 🟠 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Capital markets day disappointed, with no insider buying. Lars sees a possible drop to the open gap at 239-242 before a reversal. Key ratios are not dangerous.

#### Reasoning

Michelle holds a reduced position but misses insider buying as a sign of conviction. Lars thinks some Danish investors are exiting, which could push the stock down to fill the April gap near 240 before it turns. Dividend and profit are solid, but earnings visibility to 2030 is the key question.

#### Sell Triggers

- Break below the 239-242 gap
- Weak 2030 growth visibility
- Continued lack of insider buying

> *"Så det kan godt være, at man får presset den helt derned, og så kommer vendingen"*

---

### 🟠 MCD — McDonald's | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Michelle: near the low end of its historical range with a rising dividend, but too early. She puts it on the candidate list and won't press buy.

#### Reasoning

Rent cuts and modernisation capex for franchisees hit the most profitable revenue stream, with up to 6-year payback. Rising food and energy costs, and dependence on low-income consumers returning, add pressure. Lars also sees short-term financial strain.

#### Sell Triggers

- Remodelling fails to lift traffic
- Continued input cost inflation
- Low-income consumers do not return

> *"Det kan godt være, du kan sætte den på kandidatvægten, men jeg tror ikke, jeg vil trykke på køsknappen."*

---

### 🟠 SUBC — Subsea 7 | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Both panellists are constructive on oil service over 2-3 years: energy security, restarting old fields, multi-year offshore/subsea contracts. Subsea 7 is named as an interesting Nordic pick.

#### Reasoning

Supply security has moved up the political agenda. Offshore/subsea contracts are decided over years, which makes them less sensitive to daily oil moves. Repairs of Middle East infrastructure are coming. Lars expects big dividends and says it 'ser interessant ud'. The risk is a Hormuz deal pressuring the stocks.

#### Sell Triggers

- Iran/US deal reopening Hormuz
- Sharp oil price decline

> *"jamen så har du det der Subsea 7, som jo for eksempel er interessant inden for den her."*

---

### 🟠 ODL — Odfjell Drilling | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Named as a Nordic oil service candidate within a sector the panel sees tailwinds for.

#### Reasoning

Part of a constructive sector view on oil service and drilling, driven by energy security and field restarts. The panel suggests spreading exposure, including suppliers of valves and parts.

#### Sell Triggers

- Hormuz deal lowers oil prices

> *"Otfjeld Drilling, lige præcis."*

---

### 🟢 META — Meta | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars bought it in the stock game on algorithm signals. It has been a good investment and is near its all-time high at 777. The Meta Muse AI agent is seen as smart.

#### Reasoning

Lars follows his momentum algorithms: if the market believes in it, run with it, starting with a small position. Michelle sees Meta's data on users and its agentic app (purchasing, bookings, fewer clicks) as a strong disruptive position.

#### Sell Triggers

- Algorithms turn to sell
- AI agent adoption disappoints

> *"Nu har jeg selv købt den i Millionærklubbens spil, fordi mine algoritmer sagde det til mig"*

---

### 🟡 GN — GN Store Nord | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars holds, betting on a turnaround or bid after the SEB target of 150. Michelle has no trust in management after the hearing aid sale and would only hold if already in.

#### Reasoning

Lars: the stock has been beaten down so much that it can hardly take more, a sell-side upgrade may signal the market was too harsh, and he hopes for a takeover. Michelle: selling the best growth unit and keeping struggling Enterprise/Gaming is baffling. Sale proceeds reduce debt but don't create growth.

#### Sell Triggers

- Enterprise/Gaming fail to turn around
- No clear strategy from management

> *"Så jeg bliver der i min GN store nu og ser, hvor den skal henad."*

---

### 🟢 MSTR — Strategy | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lars sees buy signals across the board: RSI 65, upward momentum since August, a near golden cross on weekly 8/24 averages, Bollinger buy since mid-August. He advises a stop-loss.

#### Reasoning

This is a technical short-term view as a small bitcoin proxy position. Both panellists are sceptical of bitcoin itself. Michelle adds that the multiple to NAV (mNAV) is at a reasonable level, which could make the stock interesting. A similar setup in April failed.

#### Sell Triggers

- Drop of 12-13% (stop-loss)
- Bitcoin reverses
- Golden cross fails as in April

> *"Der er købsignaler over hele linjen lige i øjeblikket."*
